title: Governed write response
description: 200 of a governed write (spec-004 §5): the CLI's output, the commits the write made (`wf(…)` commits of the CLI, REQ-ARC-03) and the auto-push outcome (spec-010 §6). A failed push is still a successful write.

result.description: The CLI's JSON output, as `contracts/cli/memory-<verb>.schema.json` describes it.

status.description: `off`: no push attempted; `pushed`: pushed; `failed`: not pushed (the commit stays local).

code.description: On `failed`: a spec-010 §5 code (refused before git ran) or `push-timeout`.
